title: Washing My Hands
description: How do we wash our hands for cleanliness and health?

steps.text: I turn on the tap and wet my hands.
I take soap and lather my hands.
I rub all parts of my hands thoroughly.
I rinse off the soap with water.
I dry my hands with my towel.

title: Saying Hello
description: What do we do when meeting new people?

steps.text: I look into the eyes of the person in front of me.
I put a small smile on my face.
I gently say "Hello".
I wait for my turn and listen to them.

title: Waiting in Line
description: How does waiting in line work?

steps.text: I find where I need to line up.
I get in the back of the line.
I wait without getting too close to the person in front of me.
I keep my hands calm while waiting.
When it's my turn, I gently go forward.

title: Sharing My Toy
description: I learn to share with my friends.

steps.text: I listen to my friend and understand what they want.
I can say "In a moment" if I want.
When my turn is over, I offer the toy.
I wait while my friend plays.
When it's my turn, I take the toy back.

title: Getting Ready for School
description: What do I do when going to school?

steps.text: I put on my clothes.
I put the necessary items in my bag.
I put on my shoes.
I can go to the toilet before leaving.
I walk safely on the way to school.

title: Going to the Doctor
description: What happens during a doctor's checkup?

steps.text: I greet the doctor.
The doctor listens to me and asks questions.
If necessary, measurements are taken (fever, height, weight).
I can also say how I feel.
When our work is done, I say thank you and leave.

title: Shopping at the Market
description: I learn to stay calm at the market.

steps.text: We choose the things we will buy together.
I look at the shelves and point to what I want.
If there is too much noise, I can protect my ears.
I wait in line at the register.
When we are done, we return home.

title: Expressing My Emotion
description: I express my emotions with words.

steps.text: I listen to my body (is my heart fast, does my stomach hurt?).
I think about what emotion it feels like.
I say a short sentence: like "I'm sad", "I'm angry".
I ask for help if needed.
I can speak again once I calm down.
